_readme: Per-airline fees that search APIs can't see (they only appear on the payment page). Look each one up on the airline's own fees page, fill in amount/per/verified, and re-check every few months. 'per' is one of: passenger, passenger_sector (per passenger per direction), booking. Lap infants are not counted as paying passengers. A null amount means 'not configured yet' and the app will say so instead of guessing.

IndiGo.note: ₹249 listed on IndiGo's fee page for cards, app and net banking. Confirm whether it is charged per passenger or per passenger per sector.

Air India.note: Not configured — check Air India's fees page.
